summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for DEX Marketing by Colakin: an enterprise multi-tenant AI marketing operations SaaS platform built with React, Vite, Express, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM (Neon PostgreSQL-ready with instant Demo Store fallback), server-side Gemini AI, MCP-first CRM connectors, email and social campaign pipelines, compliance suppression center, approval workflows, visual automation engine, analytics, and automated testing.
